name: conversation-filter
conclusion_quantitative: conversation-filter (Ask) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 1 clarification rule; none for approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: conversation-filter classifies conversation content in real time into what to log in a daily memory file, what to note briefly and what to discard. It has almost no human-control rules: at medium confidence it asks a clarifying question silently and otherwise makes its best guess. It sets no approval gates, no checks on its own work and no rules for handling failure.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. When the agent is only moderately sure how to classify a message, it makes its best guess.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 1 clarification rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. At medium confidence about how to classify a message, the agent asks a clarifying question "silently".

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
